literature.headline_zh: 沙粒病毒科本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期沙粒病毒科研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: rVSV-MACV1 在受感染的细胞和病毒体中表达更高水平的 MACV GPC,但这并没有转化为更强大的 免疫应答。rVSV-MACV5 比 rVSV-MACV1 诱导更高水平的总 IgG 和中和抗体,而两种构建体诱导相似水平的 MACV 特异性 T 细胞。通过 rVSV-MACV5 初免和 rVSV-JUNV 加强,获得了最高水平的 MACV 和胡宁病毒反应性抗体。 [10.1128/jvi.00357-26]
菌血症最常见于 CCHF (n = 46),其次是 EVD (n = 16)、MVD (n = 16) 和 LF (n = 2);在非洲以外接受治疗的 27 名埃博拉病毒病患者中,有 7 名 (26%) 患有细菌合并感染。菌血症在症状出现后平均 11 天被发现,并且与脓毒症特征相关。 [10.1093/ofid/ofag404]

尽管 92.4% 的家庭报告了 LF 意识,76.6% 的家庭已接受社区宣传,但大多数家庭报告存在啮齿动物(93.7%)。多变量分析显示,将食物存放在地板上(AOR = 2.40;95% CI:1.12–5.19)和将食物存放在无盖容器中(AOR = 5.16;95% CI:1.23–21.71)与报告的家庭先前发生 LF 的几率显着较高相关。 [10.1186/s12982-026-02539-0]
大约三分之一的新生儿在婴儿期死亡,幸存者会出现持续的神经和眼科疾病。 [10.21508/1027-4065-2026-71-3-16-25]
与 LASV NP-ExoN 相比,SARS-CoV-2 ExoN 显示出更高的持续加工能力,每个结合事件去除更多的核苷酸,并且具有更快的关联率和更高的 dsRNA 亲和力,LASV NP-ExoN 的持续加工能力较低,一次去除的核苷酸更少。 [10.1128/jvi.00798-26]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: rVSV-MACV1 expressed higher levels of MACV GPC in infected cells and virions, but this did not translate to a more robust immune response. rVSV-MACV5 elicited higher levels of total IgG and neutralizing antibodies than rVSV-MACV1, while both constructs induced similar levels of MACV-specific T cells. [10.1128/jvi.00357-26]

Bacteremia was most commonly reported in CCHF (n = 46), followed by EVD (n = 16), MVD (n = 16), and LF (n = 2); of 27 EVD patients treated outside Africa, seven (26%) had bacterial coinfection. Bacteremia was detected a median of 11 days after symptom onset and was associated with sepsis features. [10.1093/ofid/ofag404]
Although 92.4% reported LF awareness and 76.6% had received community sensitisation, most households reported rodent presence (93.7%). [10.1186/s12982-026-02539-0]
Approximately one-third of newborns die in infancy, and survivors develop persistent neurological and ophthalmological disorders. [10.21508/1027-4065-2026-71-3-16-25]

SARS-CoV-2 ExoN showed higher processivity, removing more nucleotides per binding event, and had faster association rates and higher affinity for dsRNA compared to LASV NP-ExoN, which was less processive and removed fewer nucleotides at a time. [10.1128/jvi.00798-26]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期沙粒病毒科研究集中呈现以下进展。

news.headline_zh: 尼日利亚贝努埃州报告45例拉沙热疑似病例,1例确诊。
news.lead_zh: 贝努埃州卫生专员披露,过去一个月内记录45例拉沙热疑似病例,其中1例实验室确诊,无死亡报告。
key_findings_zh: 贝努埃州过去一个月出现45例拉沙热疑似病例,1例确诊阳性,无死亡 [news-e89bfcd5e4f72c5e]。
气候变化与降雨模式改变可能加剧尼日利亚及西非拉沙热传播风险 [news-41c0649192aaa5de]。
环境变化、森林砍伐和农业扩张促使人类与拉沙病毒主要宿主纳塔鼠接触增加 [news-410ed9c197c5aa6a]。
英国卫生安全局更新高后果传染病国家风险清单,为临床风险评估提供依据 [news-23a32b4b07441ec2]。
加拿大对来自乌干达、南苏丹和刚果(金)的旅客实施临时入境限制和21天强制隔离 [news-4373c7a547c7e95c]。
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 拉沙热在西非持续散发,环境与气候因素可能扩大传播范围;国际社会对病毒性出血热的防范与应对措施正在加强。
news.caveats_zh: 部分报告基于预测或历史数据,非实时暴发;个别记录缺乏具体病例数或官方风险评估。
news.headline_en: Benue State Reports 45 Suspected Lassa Fever Cases, One Confirmed.
news.lead_en: Benue State's health commissioner disclosed 45 suspected Lassa fever cases in the past month, with one laboratory-confirmed positive and no deaths.
key_findings_en: Benue State recorded 45 suspected Lassa fever cases and one confirmed positive in the past month, with no deaths [news-e89bfcd5e4f72c5e].
Climate change and shifting rainfall patterns may increase Lassa fever transmission in Nigeria and West Africa [news-41c0649192aaa5de].
Environmental changes, deforestation, and agricultural expansion heighten human contact with the primary Lassa virus reservoir, Mastomys natalensis [news-410ed9c197c5aa6a].
The UK Health Security Agency updated its country risk list for high-consequence infectious diseases to support clinical risk assessment [news-23a32b4b07441ec2].
Canada imposed temporary entry restrictions and a 21-day mandatory quarantine for travelers from Uganda, South Sudan, and the DRC [news-4373c7a547c7e95c].
news.trend_or_risk_en: Lassa fever continues to circulate sporadically in West Africa, with environmental and climatic factors potentially expanding transmission; international preparedness and response measures for viral hemorrhagic fevers are being strengthened.
news.caveats_en: Some reports are based on projections or historical data, not real-time outbreaks; a few records lack specific case counts or official risk assessments.
news.brief_en: Nigeria's Benue State reported 45 suspected Lassa fever cases and one confirmed case in the past month, with no deaths. Climate and environmental changes are driving increased transmission risk in West Africa. The UK updated its HCID country risk list, and Canada imposed travel restrictions on several African nations amid Ebola concerns.

papers.title: Immunogenicity of recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus-vectored vaccines expressing the Machupo virus glycoprotein in different genome positions
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) is a powerful vaccine platform that elicits durable cellular and humoral immune responses. rVSV vaccines have successfully been used for various hemorrhagic fever-causing viruses. Here, we create and evaluate rVSV vaccines for Machupo virus (MACV), a highly pathogenic New World (NW) mammarenavirus that causes Bolivian hemorrhagic fever. VSV genome rearrangements impact attenuation of the viral vector and the immune response to the vaccine. Therefore, in this study, we directly compare the effect of altering the MACV glycoprotein complex (GPC) position in the VSV genome on humoral and cellular immune responses to vaccination by evaluating replication, antigen expression, and immunogenicity of rVSVs expressing MACV GPC in the first position of the genome (rVSV-MACV1) and in the traditional glycoprotein gene position (rVSV-MACV5). rVSV-MACV1 expresses higher levels of MACV GPC in infected cells and in virions, but the increased antigen does not translate to a more robust immune response. rVSV-MACV5 elicits higher levels of total IgG and neutralizing antibodies than rVSV-MACV1, but similar levels of MACV-specific T cells. To further investigate vaccine strategies for MACV and other NW arenaviruses such as Junín virus (JUNV), we evaluated the humoral immune response to sequential immunization with rVSVs expressing MACV and JUNV GPCs. The highest levels of MACV and JUNV reactive antibodies were achieved using an rVSV-MACV5 prime followed by rVSV-JUNV boost. The data from our study have implications for rVSV vaccine design and provide a foundation for the development of rVSV-vectored vaccines for MACV and other NW arenaviruses. IMPORTANCE Machupo virus (MACV) is a highly pathogenic New World (NW) mammarenavirus that causes Bolivian hemorrhagic fever (BHF). Because of their high mortality rates, MACV and other NW arenaviruses represent a significant public health threat. However, no approved vaccines for MACV exist. Here, we describe recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) vaccines that express the MACV glycoprotein complex (GPC) in different positions of the VSV genome and characterize the humoral and cellular immune response to each. We also investigate sequential immunization with rVSVs expressing MACV GPC and a related NW arenaviral antigen, Junín virus GPC, in an effort to elicit broadly cross-reactive antibody responses. The conclusions from our study are twofold: data presented here provide further understanding of rVSV vaccine vectors and how genome rearrangements can be leveraged for vaccine development, and the results from our study may inform future vaccine development for MACV and other NW arenaviruses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study was needed because no approved vaccines exist for Machupo virus (MACV), a highly pathogenic New World mammarenavirus that causes Bolivian hemorrhagic fever with high mortality rates. The study aimed to evaluate recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) vaccines expressing MACV glycoprotein complex (GPC) in different genome positions and investigate sequential immunization with MACV and Junín virus GPCs to elicit cross-reactive antibody responses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved creating and evaluating rVSV vaccines for MACV by comparing two constructs: rVSV-MACV1 with MACV GPC in the first genome position and rVSV-MACV5 with MACV GPC in the traditional glycoprotein position. Additionally, sequential immunization with rVSVs expressing MACV and Junín virus GPCs was evaluated to assess humoral immune responses.
analysis.methods: The study evaluated replication, antigen expression, and immunogenicity of the rVSV constructs by measuring MACV GPC levels in infected cells and virions. Humoral immune responses were assessed through total IgG, neutralizing antibodies, and MACV-specific T cells, with sequential immunization strategies tested using rVSV-MACV5 prime followed by rVSV-JUNV boost.
analysis.main_results: rVSV-MACV1 expressed higher levels of MACV GPC in infected cells and virions, but this did not translate to a more robust immune response. rVSV-MACV5 elicited higher levels of total IgG and neutralizing antibodies than rVSV-MACV1, while both constructs induced similar levels of MACV-specific T cells. The highest levels of MACV and Junín virus reactive antibodies were achieved with an rVSV-MACV5 prime followed by rVSV-JUNV boost.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that genome rearrangements in rVSV vectors impact attenuation and immune responses, but increased antigen expression does not necessarily enhance immunogenicity. The novelty lies in demonstrating that the traditional glycoprotein gene position (rVSV-MACV5) is optimal for eliciting humoral immunity and that sequential immunization with related New World arenaviruses can enhance cross-reactive antibody responses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a foundation for rVSV-vectored vaccine development for MACV and other New World arenaviruses, informing strategies to improve immunogenicity through genome positioning and sequential immunization. This could enhance surveillance, prevention, and control of Bolivian hemorrhagic fever and related hemorrhagic fevers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the focus on in vitro and immunogenicity endpoints without challenge data or clinical evaluation. The evidence strength is moderate, as the study provides robust comparative data on immune responses but lacks real-world efficacy validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) vaccines expressing Machupo virus (MACV) glycoprotein complex (GPC) in different genome positions to address the lack of approved vaccines for MACV, which causes Bolivian hemorrhagic fever. The researchers compared rVSV-MACV1 (GPC in first position) and rVSV-MACV5 (GPC in traditional position), finding that rVSV-MACV5 elicited higher humoral immunity despite lower antigen expression. Sequential immunization with rVSV-MACV5 prime and rVSV-JUNV boost further enhanced cross-reactive antibodies. The study provides insights into rVSV vaccine design and a foundation for developing vaccines against MACV and other New World arenaviruses, though clinical efficacy remains untested.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 之所以需要这项研究,是因为马丘波病毒 (MACV) 尚无获批的 疫苗,马丘波病毒是一种高致病性新大陆乳腺病毒,可导致玻利维亚出血热,死亡率 发病率很高。The study aimed to evaluate recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) 疫苗 expressing MACV glycoprotein complex (GPC) in different 基因组 positions and investigate sequential immunization with MACV and Junín virus GPCs to elicit cross-reactive antibody responses.
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及通过比较两种构建体来创建和评估 MACV 的 rVSV 疫苗:rVSV-MACV1 在第一个 基因组 位置具有 MACV GPC,rVSV-MACV5 在传统糖蛋白位置具有 MACV GPC。此外,还评估了表达 MACV 的 rVSV 和胡宁病毒 GPC 的顺序免疫,以评估体液 免疫应答。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究通过测量受感染细胞和病毒粒子中的 MACV GPC 水平来评估 rVSV 构建体的复制、抗原表达和免疫原性。通过总 IgG、中和抗体和 MACV 特异性 T 细胞评估体液 免疫应答,并使用 rVSV-MACV5 初免和 rVSV-JUNV 加强测试顺序免疫策略。
elements_zh.main_results: rVSV-MACV1 在受感染的细胞和病毒体中表达更高水平的 MACV GPC,但这并没有转化为更强大的 免疫应答。rVSV-MACV5 比 rVSV-MACV1 诱导更高水平的总 IgG 和中和抗体,而两种构建体诱导相似水平的 MACV 特异性 T 细胞。通过 rVSV-MACV5 初免和 rVSV-JUNV 加强,获得了最高水平的 MACV 和胡宁病毒反应性抗体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,rVSV 媒介 中的 基因组 重排影响减毒和 免疫应答,但抗原表达增加并不一定会增强免疫原性。新颖之处在于证明传统的糖蛋白基因位置(rVSV-MACV5)最适合引发体液免疫,并且用相关的 New World 沙粒病毒 进行顺序免疫可以增强交叉反应性抗体反应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 MACV 和其他新世界 沙粒病毒 的 rVSV 载体 疫苗 开发奠定了基础,为通过 基因组 定位和序贯免疫提高免疫原性的策略提供了信息。这可以加强 监测、玻利维亚出血热及相关出血热的预防和控制。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括关注体外和免疫原性终点,而没有挑战数据或临床评估。证据强度中等,因为该研究提供了 免疫应答 的可靠比较数据,但缺乏现实世界的疗效验证。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 之所以需要这项研究,是因为马丘波病毒 (MACV) 尚无获批的 疫苗,马丘波病毒是一种高致病性新大陆乳腺病毒,可导致玻利维亚出血热,死亡率 发病率很高。The study aimed to evaluate recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) 疫苗 expressing MACV glycoprotein complex (GPC) in different 基因组 positions and investigate sequential immunization with MACV and Junín virus GPCs to elicit cross-reactive antibody responses.
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及通过比较两种构建体来创建和评估 MACV 的 rVSV 疫苗:rVSV-MACV1 在第一个 基因组 位置具有 MACV GPC,rVSV-MACV5 在传统糖蛋白位置具有 MACV GPC。此外,还评估了表达 MACV 的 rVSV 和胡宁病毒 GPC 的顺序免疫,以评估体液 免疫应答。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究通过测量受感染细胞和病毒粒子中的 MACV GPC 水平来评估 rVSV 构建体的复制、抗原表达和免疫原性。通过总 IgG、中和抗体和 MACV 特异性 T 细胞评估体液 免疫应答,并使用 rVSV-MACV5 初免和 rVSV-JUNV 加强测试顺序免疫策略。
analysis_zh.main_results: rVSV-MACV1 在受感染的细胞和病毒体中表达更高水平的 MACV GPC,但这并没有转化为更强大的 免疫应答。rVSV-MACV5 比 rVSV-MACV1 诱导更高水平的总 IgG 和中和抗体,而两种构建体诱导相似水平的 MACV 特异性 T 细胞。通过 rVSV-MACV5 初免和 rVSV-JUNV 加强,获得了最高水平的 MACV 和胡宁病毒反应性抗体。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,rVSV 媒介 中的 基因组 重排影响减毒和 免疫应答,但抗原表达增加并不一定会增强免疫原性。新颖之处在于证明传统的糖蛋白基因位置(rVSV-MACV5)最适合引发体液免疫,并且用相关的 New World 沙粒病毒 进行顺序免疫可以增强交叉反应性抗体反应。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 MACV 和其他新世界 沙粒病毒 的 rVSV 载体 疫苗 开发奠定了基础,为通过 基因组 定位和序贯免疫提高免疫原性的策略提供了信息。这可以加强 监测、玻利维亚出血热及相关出血热的预防和控制。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括关注体外和免疫原性终点,而没有挑战数据或临床评估。证据强度中等,因为该研究提供了 免疫应答 的可靠比较数据,但缺乏现实世界的疗效验证。

papers.title: Bacterial infection in Ebola virus disease, Marburg virus disease, Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever, and Lassa fever
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Concern for bacterial coinfection in patients with high consequence viral infections (HCVIs) has made the empiric antibiotic administration the standard of care. However, the incidence, microbiology, and clinical significance of bacterial coinfection in HCVIs remain unclear. Methods We conducted a systematic review of case reports, cohort studies, and cross-sectional analyses describing bacterial coinfection in Ebola virus disease (EVD), Marburg virus disease (MVD), Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF), and Lassa fever (LF). Data were extracted on study design, setting, diagnostic methods, pathogens, antibiotic use, and outcomes. Results Thirty publications met inclusion criteria. Bacteremia was most commonly reported among patients with CCHF (n = 46), followed by EVD (n = 16), MVD (n = 16), and LF (n = 2). Of 27 EVD patients treated outside Africa, seven (26%) had bacterial coinfection. Across HCVIs, bacteremia was detected a median of 11 days after symptom onset (range 0–23) and was associated with features of sepsis. Pathogens included enteric flora, healthcare-associated organisms, opportunistic pathogens, and zoonotic bacteria—most notably Brucella spp. Ceftriaxone was the most common empiric antibiotic but is predicted to have activity against a minority of bloodstream isolates. Mortality among coinfected patients with EVD or MVD was similar to those without bacterial coinfection, whereas coinfected CCHF patients had higher mortality than those without coinfection (15.5%; 95% CI 8.0–25.9% vs 5.7%; 95% CI 5.1–6.4%). Conclusions Despite being a major concern driving empiric antibiotic use, bacterial coinfection in HCVIs remains poorly described, precluding determination of its incidence or clinical significance. Prospective studies with standardized protocols for bacterial diagnosis and characterization of antimicrobial resistance are needed to guide antimicrobial strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 由于对高后果病毒感染 (HCVI) 患者细菌合并感染的担忧,经验性抗生素给药已成为护理标准。然而,HCVI 中细菌共感染的 发病率、微生物学和临床意义仍不清楚。方法 我们对 病例报告、队列研究 研究以及描述埃博拉病毒病 (EVD)、马尔堡病毒病 (MVD)、克里米亚-刚果出血热 (CCHF) 和 拉沙热 (LF) 细菌共感染的横断面分析进行了系统回顾。提取了有关研究设计、设置、诊断方法、病原体、抗生素使用和结果的数据。结果 30 篇出版物符合纳入标准。菌血症在 CCHF 患者中最常见 (n = 46),其次是 EVD (n = 16)、MVD (n = 16) 和 LF (n = 2)。在非洲以外地区接受治疗的 27 名埃博拉病毒病患者中,有 7 名 (26%) 患有细菌合并感染。在 HCVI 中,菌血症在症状出现后的中位时间(范围 0-23)检测到 11 天,并且与败血症的特征相关。病原体包括肠道菌群、医疗保健相关微生物、机会性病原体和人畜共患细菌,尤其是布鲁氏菌属。头孢曲松是最常见的经验性抗生素,但预计对少数血流分离株具有活性。EVD 或 MVD 合并感染患者的 死亡率 与未合并细菌感染的患者相似,而合并 CCHF 患者的 死亡率 高于未合并感染的患者(15.5%;95% CI 8.0–25.9% vs 5.7%;95% CI 5.1–6.4%)。结论 尽管是推动经验性抗生素使用的一个主要问题,但 HCVI 中的细菌合并感染的描述仍然很少,从而无法确定其 发病率 或临床意义。需要对细菌 诊断 的标准化方案和抗菌药物耐药性特征进行前瞻性研究来指导抗菌策略。

papers.title: Congenital infection caused by lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus: little-known problem in modern perinatal medicine
papers.abstract: Congenital infections play a significant role in perinatal pathology. Of particular interest is the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (Lymphocytic choriomeningitis, ICD-10: A87.2), which has pronounced neurotropic and teratogenic effects. Congenital infection caused by the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus is characterized by microcephaly, hydrocephalus, periventricular calcifications, and visual and auditory lesions. Diagnosis is based on the identification of characteristic structural abnormalities during prenatal screening ultrasound and confirmation of the viral etiology of the disease. Specific antiviral drugs and vaccines against the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus are currently unavailable, so treatment is supportive. Approximately one-third of newborns die in infancy, and survivors develop persistent neurological and ophthalmological disorders. Given the underestimated prevalence of this virus, this work aims to systematize current data on the pathogenesis, clinical features, diagnosis, and prognosis of congenital infection caused by the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus.
papers.journal: Rossiyskiy Vestnik Perinatologii i Pediatrii (Russian Bulletin of Perinatology and Pediatrics)

papers.title_zh: 淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒引起的先天性感染:现代围产医学鲜为人知的问题
papers.source_body_en: Congenital infections play a significant role in perinatal pathology. Of particular interest is the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (Lymphocytic choriomeningitis, ICD-10: A87.2), which has pronounced neurotropic and teratogenic effects. Congenital infection caused by the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus is characterized by microcephaly, hydrocephalus, periventricular calcifications, and visual and auditory lesions. Diagnosis is based on the identification of characteristic structural abnormalities during prenatal screening ultrasound and confirmation of the viral etiology of the disease. Specific antiviral drugs and vaccines against the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus are currently unavailable, so treatment is supportive. Approximately one-third of newborns die in infancy, and survivors develop persistent neurological and ophthalmological disorders. Given the underestimated prevalence of this virus, this work aims to systematize current data on the pathogenesis, clinical features, diagnosis, and prognosis of congenital infection caused by the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus.

papers.title: Knowledge and preventive practices of Lassa fever among residents of Ife-Odan Community, Osun State, South-West Nigeria
papers.abstract: Lassa fever is a disease of public health importance with high mortality and morbidity especially among rural dwellers. Lassa fever is an acute viral hemorrhagic fever caused by Lassa virus. The virus is a single-stranded RNA virus which belongs to the virus family Arenaviridae. It is an old-world arena virus, which is enveloped, single-stranded, and bi-segmented RNA. Lassa fever is a zoonotic disease, the animal reservoir of Lassa virus is a rodent of the genus Mastomys, commonly known as the “multimammate rat.” Mastomys rats infected with Lassa virus do not become ill, but they can shed the virus in their urine and faeces for the rest of their lifetime creating ample opportunity for exposure and transmission The study is a cross-sectional study which was carried out in Ife-Odan community. Ife-Odan, It is a rural community, a town in Osun State which has its headquarters in Ejigbo local government area. The population of Ife-Odan was estimated to be 372,191 according to the national population census of the LGA according to the 2016 national population census. The Sampling technique that was used for this study is Multi-stage sampling technique. The sample size was calculated using the Leslie Kish formula for estimation of single proportions in a population with more than 10,000 inhabitants. The formula used: N= It was observed that Sixty-seven percent of the respondents had heard about Lassa fever, another 58.4% of them knew that rat is the vector. More than half (58.6%), of the respondents knew that the disease is deadly, treatable (53.0%) and survivable (51.9%). Forty-three percent of them say it can be transmitted from one person to another, about half (50.5%) agreed that spreading food by the road side is a risk factor along with poor refuse disposal and dirty environment (50.9%), bush burning (34.9%) and exposing food stuff at home (53.0%). More individuals identified headache (55.3%) as the symptom of Lassa fever. As regards the preventive practices of the respondents, 63.7% eat rats and 36.7% spread food by the road side. Seventy-seven percent of the respondents clear the bush around their homes regularly. Most of the respondents (81.4%) store their food in covered containers and about half them practice bush burning. Two hundred and sixty-eight (62.3%) of the respondents practice unsanitary waste disposal method (open dumping) and large fraction of the population uses rodenticides (76.0%) to kill rats. Significant association was found between respondent’s demographic characteristics, level of education and surprisingly, marital status. Respondents with categorized knowledge scores were assessed. Individuals who were less than 19years of age were realized to have better knowledge about Lassa fever compared to those in other age groups. It was also recorded that Respondents with tertiary level of education have the best knowledge on Lassa fever. Surprisingly, respondents that are single were found to have better knowledge about Lassa fever compared to the married group. These findings are in contrast with studies assessing marital status and its implications on health shown in a previous study.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Lassa fever is a disease of public health importance with high mortality and morbidity especially among rural dwellers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a cross-sectional study which was carried out in Ife-Odan community, a rural town in Osun State with an estimated population of 372,191 according to the 2016 national population census.
analysis.methods: The Sampling technique that was used for this study is Multi-stage sampling technique, and the sample size was calculated using the Leslie Kish formula for estimation of single proportions in a population with more than 10,000 inhabitants.
analysis.main_results: Sixty-seven percent of the respondents had heard about Lassa fever, 58.4% knew that rat is the vector, and 58.6% knew that the disease is deadly, treatable (53.0%) and survivable (51.9%). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings are in contrast with studies assessing marital status and its implications on health shown in a previous study, as respondents that are single were found to have better knowledge about Lassa fever compared to the married group.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the need for targeted health education interventions to improve knowledge and preventive practices of Lassa fever in rural communities, particularly among married individuals and those with lower education levels.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed knowledge and preventive practices of Lassa fever among residents of Ife-Odan Community, Osun State, Nigeria. The study found that 67% of respondents had heard about Lassa fever, with 58.4% aware that rats are the vector. Knowledge levels varied significantly by age, education, and marital status, with younger, more educated, and single individuals showing better understanding. Despite this, preventive practices were suboptimal, with 63.7% eating rats and 62.3% practicing unsanitary waste disposal. The study highlights the need for targeted health education to improve awareness and reduce risk factors in rural communities.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 死亡率 是一种具有重要公共卫生意义的疾病,其发病率很高,尤其是在农村居民中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项横断面研究,在奥孙州的一个乡村小镇 Ife-Odan 社区进行,根据 2016 年全国人口普查,该社区的人口估计为 372,191 人。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究使用的抽样技术是多阶段抽样技术,样本量是使用 Leslie Kish 公式计算的,用于估计居民超过 10,000 人的人口中的单一比例。
elements_zh.main_results: 67%的受访者听说过拉沙热,58.4%的人知道老鼠就是媒介,58.6%的人知道这种疾病是致命的、可治疗的(53.0%)和可生存的(51.9%)。受访者的人口特征、教育水平和婚姻状况之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现与之前研究中评估婚姻状况及其对健康影响的研究形成鲜明对比,因为与已婚群体相比,单身受访者对 拉沙热 有更好的了解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调需要采取有针对性的健康教育干预措施,以提高农村社区,特别是已婚人士和教育水平较低者的 拉沙热 知识和预防实践。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法建立因果关系,并且由于依赖自我报告的数据和潜在的选择偏差,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Household practices associated with reported household Lassa fever occurrence in hyperendemic communities of Edo state, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Lassa fever (LF) remains a major public health threat in Nigeria, with Edo State designated a hyperendemic hotspot. Despite high community awareness and ongoing public health interventions, households continue to report LF annually, suggesting that household-level practices may be associated with the observed disease patterns. This study investigated household practices associated with self-reported prior household LF occurrence in Ekpoma communities, Edo State. An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among household heads or representatives selected through multistage sampling between June and August 2023. Data on socio-demographics, LF knowledge, and household practices were collected using an interviewer-administered questionnaire. Associations between household practices and self-reported household LF occurrence within 12 months preceding the study were assessed using the chi-square test and multivariate logistic regression. The level of significance was set at P < 0.05. Among 303 respondents recruited for the study, more than half were male (58.1%) and middle-aged (mean age: 44.6 ± 17.8 years). Farmers (26.4%) and entrepreneurs (26.1%) were the largest occupational groups. Although 92.4% reported LF awareness and 76.6% had received community sensitisation, most households reported rodent presence (93.7%). Furthermore, 53.8% stored food in open containers and 19.1% stored food on the floor. Multivariate analysis showed that storing food on the floor (AOR = 2.40; 95% CI: 1.12–5.19) and storing food in uncovered containers (AOR = 5.16; 95% CI: 1.23–21.71) were associated with significantly higher odds of reported prior household LF occurrence. The findings highlight a potential knowledge-to-practice gap in Lassa fever prevention in hyperendemic communities. Household food storage practices, particularly food storage on the floor and in uncovered containers, were associated with reported prior household LF occurrence, underscoring the need to strengthen community-based food storage and environmental sanitation interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 拉沙热 仍然是尼日利亚的主要公共卫生威胁,埃多州被指定为高流行热点。尽管社区意识很高并且正在进行公共卫生干预,但家庭每年仍继续报告 LF,这表明家庭层面的做法可能与观察到的疾病模式有关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2023年6月至8月期间通过多阶段抽样选出的户主或代表进行了一项横断面分析研究。在该研究招募的303名受访者中,一半以上是男性(58.1%)和中年人(平均年龄:44.6±17.8岁)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用访谈者管理的问卷收集有关社会人口统计、低频知识和家庭实践的数据。使用卡方检验和多元逻辑回归评估家庭实践与研究前 12 个月内自我报告的家庭 LF 发生率之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 尽管 92.4% 的家庭报告了 LF 意识,76.6% 的家庭已接受社区宣传,但大多数家庭报告存在啮齿动物(93.7%)。多变量分析显示,将食物存放在地板上(AOR = 2.40;95% CI:1.12–5.19)和将食物存放在无盖容器中(AOR = 5.16;95% CI:1.23–21.71)与报告的家庭先前发生 LF 的几率显着较高相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了高流行社区 拉沙热 预防中潜在的知识与实践差距。家庭食物储存做法,特别是放在地板上和无盖容器中的食物储存,与之前报告的家庭 LF 发生有关,强调需要加强以社区为基础的食物储存和环境卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究确定了增加 拉沙热 传播 风险的具体家庭做法,为有针对性的干预措施提供了可行的见解。加强社区食品储存和环境卫生可以减少高流行地区家庭 LF 的发生。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于自我报告的家庭 LF 发生情况,这可能会引入回忆偏差。尽管如此,由于样本量较大并且使用多变量分析来控制混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Distinct modes of RNA degradation by the structurally related coronavirus and arenavirus exoribonucleases.
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Coronaviruses and arenaviruses encode evolutionarily related DEDDh-family 3'-5' exoribonuclease (ExoN) domains, which support the replication of their RNA genomes and evasion of the host's antiviral immunity. Here, we report comparative biochemical analyses of SARS-CoV-2 and Lassa virus (LASV) ExoN, which show that the two enzymes have distinct characteristics despite structural conservation and their shared preference for double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) substrates. SARS-CoV-2 nsp14/10 exhibits a highly processive behavior and tends to remove many nucleotides upon each binding event. By contrast, LASV NP-ExoN exhibits a less processive behavior and removes fewer nucleotides upon each binding event. The two enzymes also show a difference in the minimal dsRNA length for efficient degradation. We show that nsp14/10 associates with a dsRNA substrate at a faster rate than NP-ExoN and correspondingly has a higher affinity for dsRNA, which is likely to account for the higher processivity. These observations help to understand the biological functions of the viral ExoN enzymes and underscore roles for nsp14/10 beyond proofreading. IMPORTANCE: Coronaviruses such as SARS-CoV-2 and arenaviruses such as Lassa virus (LASV) share a structurally similar exoribonuclease (ExoN) domain as part of the viral non-structural protein 14 (nsp14) and nucleoprotein (NP), respectively, which degrades RNA strands from the 3' terminus. The ExoN activity of coronavirus nsp14 is known for its role in proofreading, where it removes nucleotides misincorporated during viral RNA synthesis, whereas that of arenavirus NP is known for its importance in suppressing the host's immune response by degrading immunostimulatory RNAs. In this study, we show that SARS-CoV-2 ExoN is highly processive and removes many nucleotides upon each binding event, whereas LASV NP ExoN is less processive and removes fewer nucleotides at a time. We further show that the contrasting behaviors are attributable to distinct RNA-binding kinetics of these two viral enzymes. These observations help to understand the biological roles of the viral ExoN enzymes and suggest their pleiotropic functions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare the biochemical characteristics of structurally related exoribonucleases (ExoN) from SARS-CoV-2 and Lassa virus to understand their distinct roles in viral replication and immune evasion.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study performed comparative biochemical analyses of SARS-CoV-2 nsp14/10 and Lassa virus NP-ExoN enzymes using double-stranded RNA substrates.
analysis.methods: The researchers analyzed the processivity, nucleotide removal efficiency, minimal dsRNA length requirements, and RNA-binding kinetics of both enzymes through biochemical assays.
analysis.main_results: SARS-CoV-2 ExoN showed higher processivity, removing more nucleotides per binding event, and had faster association rates and higher affinity for dsRNA compared to LASV NP-ExoN, which was less processive and removed fewer nucleotides at a time.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the distinct behaviors as evidence for pleiotropic functions beyond proofreading, highlighting differences in RNA-binding kinetics that explain the contrasting enzymatic activities.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings enhance understanding of viral ExoN mechanisms, potentially informing antiviral strategies targeting RNA degradation pathways in both coronaviruses and arenaviruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is high due to direct biochemical comparisons, though the study is limited to in vitro analyses without in vivo validation or broader viral diversity testing.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared the biochemical properties of SARS-CoV-2 and Lassa virus ExoN enzymes, revealing distinct degradation mechanisms despite structural similarities. SARS-CoV-2 nsp14/10 exhibited higher processivity, faster RNA binding, and greater affinity for dsRNA substrates compared to LASV NP-ExoN, which was less processive and removed fewer nucleotides per binding event. These differences in RNA-binding kinetics explain the contrasting enzymatic behaviors and suggest pleiotropic functions beyond proofreading for both enzymes. The findings provide mechanistic insights into viral RNA degradation strategies, with potential implications for antiviral development targeting these conserved enzymatic domains.

papers.title: Emerging Mammarenaviruses in Wildlife: Expanding Host Range and Implications
papers.abstract: Mammarenaviruses are enveloped, ambisense, single-stranded RNA viruses capable of causing fatal hemorrhagic fevers and severe neurological disorders in humans. Although muroid rodents have historically been recognized as the primary reservoirs for major pathogens like Lassa virus, recent surveillance has revealed a significant expansion of their host range. This review aims to synthesize current global data regarding the epidemiology of mammarenaviruses in conventional reservoirs and the emergence of novel arenaviruses in non-traditional mammalian hosts. To achieve this, we comprehensively analyzed recent molecular and metagenomic surveillance data, evolutionary studies, and epidemiological reports published worldwide. Key discoveries include Wenzhou virus in Asian house shrews, Plateau Pika virus in plateau pikas, and an independent, geographically clustered of hedgehog-associated arenaviruses across Europe. Ultimately, this review underscores the global distribution of these pathogens and the critical need for continued, multi-host surveillance worldwide.

papers.title: In vitro inhibition of STAT5 signaling limits CD8+ T cell exhaustion and improves outcomes in adoptive T-cell therapy.
papers.abstract: T cell exhaustion remains a barrier to adoptive cell therapies. Although γc cytokines are used to expand T cells, their impact on T cell states remains incompletely defined. Using an in vitro model of repetitive TCR stimulation, we found that high-dose IL-2 or IL-15 promoted exhausted CD8+ T cell (TEX) differentiation, with increased inhibitory receptor expression and loss of stem-like features. During chronic LCMV Clone 13 infection, high IL2Rβ expression marked virus-specific CD8+ T cells with features of terminally exhausted TEX cells, whereas IL2Rβ deficiency favored progenitor-like populations. In TEX cells, IL-2 and IL-15 preferentially induced STAT5 phosphorylation over other signaling pathways. Genetic disruption of STAT5 similarly supported progenitor subsets, implicating STAT5 in the progression toward more differentiated TEX states under chronic stimulation. We therefore asked whether transient STAT5 attenuation during in vitro T cell expansion could bias differentiation toward progenitor-like populations without compromising functional competence. Transient JAK3 or STAT5 inhibition enriched TCF1+Ly108+ progenitor-like cells while preserving cytokine production and degranulation capacity. Following transfer into tumor-bearing mice, cells expanded under STAT5-inhibited (STAT5i) conditions mediated superior tumor control and prolonged survival. Likewise, transient STAT5 inhibition preserved memory-progenitor phenotypes in human CD22 CAR T cells without impairing cytotoxicity. RNA sequencing of STAT5i-expanded CD8+ T cells confirmed reinforced stem-like transcriptional programs and reduced enrichment of effector and exhausted signatures. Together, these findings identify the IL-2Rβ-STAT5 axis as a regulator of CD8+ T cell differentiation and support transient STAT5 modulation during ex vivo expansion to improve therapeutic T cell products.

news.content_title: Benue Records 45 Suspected Lassa Fever Cases, Confirms One Positive
news.content: Benue State Commissioner for Health and Human Services, Dr Paul Ogwuche, yesterday said the number of suspected Lassa fever cases recorded in the last one month stand at 45 with one confirmed positive. Ogwuche further disclosed that there is no mortality in the last one month in the state. The commissioner, had in June revealed that one doctor had died from Lassa fever in Benue. Giving an update yesterday, the commissioner said there have been no deaths recorded in the past one month. According to him, laboratory tests carried out confirmed case of Lassa fever was recorded in the state within the last month, with no death reported during the period. Ogwuche announced this while briefing newsmen in Makurdi on the state’s Lassa fever situation report covering Epidemiological Week 27, from June 28 to date. He explained that despite the decline in the peak transmission season, the Ministry of Health and Human Services has maintained intensive disease surveillance and rapid response activities across the state’s 23 local government areas to guard against any resurgence of the disease. news.content: Follow Us on Google News MENU News News NigeriaExplore the latest updates in Nigeria AfricaExplore the latest updates in Africa EuropeExplore the latest updates in Europe AsiaExplore the latest updates in Asia WorldExplore the latest updates in WorldEpaperMetroPoliticsBusiness Business AviationExplore the latest updates in Aviation Business NewsExplore the latest updates in Business News BusinessAgroExplore the latest updates in BusinessAgro Stock MarketExplore the latest updates in Stock Market Capital MarketExplore the latest updates in Capital Market EntrepreneurExplore the latest updates in Entrepreneur IndustryExplore the latest updates in Industry InsuranceExplore the latest updates in Insurance MaritimeExplore the latest updates in Maritime MoneyExplore the latest updates in Money Security WatchExplore the latest updates in Security WatchSportLife Life MusicExplore the latest updates in Music FilmExplore the latest updates in Film BeautyExplore the latest updates in Beauty FeaturesExplore the latest updates in FeaturesOpinionTech Tech ReviewedExplore the latest updates in ReviewedGTVWoman Woman GWFExplore the latest updates in GWF e-Paper Others Property Contributors Guardian Arts Guardian Weekend Cartoons Education Saturday Magazine Columnists Environment Executive Motoring Aviation Maritime Law Odd News Subscribe Search Guardian News Environmental changes help spread lassa fever in West Africa – Expert By : Solomon Azu Date: 20 July 2026 6:36pm WAT Share : Follow Us on Google Discover lassa-fever lassa-fever Research findings by Cochrane Nigeria has identified environmental changes, expanding human settlements and biodiversity loss as key factors driving the spread of Lassa fever in West Africa. The findings was presented during a two-day Evidence-Based Healthcare Reporting Workshop and Media Round Table organised by Cochrane Nigeria in collaboration with the University of Calabar Teaching Hospital (UCTH) and the University of Calabar. The presentation, facilitated by Dr. Esu, was delivered to selected journalists in Calabar as part of efforts to strengthen evidence-based health reporting and improve public understanding of scientific research. Dr. Esu explained that Lassa fever is a viral haemorrhagic disease caused by the Lassa virus (LASV), which is primarily transmitted through contact with the urine, faeces, saliva or blood of infected multimammate rats (Mastomys natalensis), the virus’ principal reservoir. Drawing from a 2025 systematic review that analysed studies conducted between 1969 and 2023, he identified three major environmental drivers of Lassa virus transmission. According to him, seasonal rainfall patterns significantly influence the movement and population of rodents, resulting in increased human infections during the dry season when the animals move into homes in search of food. He also noted that agricultural expansion, deforestation and the conversion of natural habitats into human settlements create favourable conditions for rodents to thrive close to people. Poor food storage and housing conditions, he added, further heighten the risk of transmission. Speaking on biodiversity, Dr. Esu said although Mastomys natalensis remains the primary reservoir of the virus, other rodent species may also carry Lassa virus, raising concerns about its spread into new areas. He added that maintaining biodiversity could help reduce infection risks by limiting the dominance of infected rodent populations. The facilitator stressed that while scientific evidence clearly links environmental factors to Lassa fever outbreaks, important research gaps remain, particularly concerning seasonal changes and biodiversity loss. He warned that climate change, through rising temperatures and changing rainfall patterns, is likely to expand areas suitable for the virus, exposing more communities to infection. Dr. Esu emphasised the need for a One Health approach that integrates human, animal and environmental health to guide evidence-based policies capable of preventing future outbreaks and protecting vulnerable populations. The workshop equipped journalists with practical skills for interpreting and reporting health research accurately, reinforcing the critical role of the media in combating misinformation and promoting evidence-based public health reporting. Its approach is built around strategy, creativity, consistency, and commercial relevance, making it a strong partner for companies that want their brand to leave a lasting mark in their industry, market, and community. This product brings together brand strategy, content direction, copywriting, digital marketing, campaign planning, and website/social media alignment. It is designed to help businesses stop posting randomly and start communicating with purpose. Every piece of content, campaign, and digital touchpoint is shaped to strengthen the brand’s credibility, improve customer trust, and support growth. Sponsored Novus Consult Brand Identity Design Novus Consult develops foundational brand identity systems for early-stage and scaling businesses that need a professional, memorable, and market-ready presence. This includes logo design, identity marks, colour palette development, typography direction, moodboards, visual grids, taglines, brand naming, merchandise direction, website direction, and website design and development. The goal is to create a complete visual system that helps businesses look credible, consistent, and recognizable across every customer touchpoint. Ad • Novus Consult 29s Recent media reports referencing a catastrophic Ebola death toll surpassing 1,000 have reignited urgent conversations across Africa regarding the continent's fragile preparedness for viral hemorrhagic fevers. While a July 2026 report by Nigerian financial outlet Nairametrics highlighted these alarming figures, global health authorities clarify that the data mirrors the devastating milestones of the 2019 Kivu epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo, rather than a new, synchronized outbreak of that magnitude today. However, the rapid digital circulation of these figures underscores a persistent anxiety among health policymakers. The ongoing battle against localized clusters of viral pathogens continues to strain health ministries from Abuja to Kampala, revealing that the structural vulnerabilities exposed during past epidemics remain largely unresolved. The conversation has now shifted from mere reactive containment to the necessity of permanent, proactive epidemiological infrastructure. The Legacy of the 1,000-Death Milestone The psychological threshold of 1,000 fatalities holds deep significance in global epidemiology. During the 2018–2020 Kivu outbreak in the DRC, surpassing this number in May 2019 marked a turning point that forced the World Health Organization (WHO) to escalate its intervention strategies amidst active conflict zones. The earlier 2014–2016 West African epidemic, which claimed over 11,300 lives primarily in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, demonstrated how rapidly localized infections can spiral into transnational security threats. Today, infectious disease experts warn that while large-scale fatalities have been mitigated by new therapeutics, the baseline risk has not diminished. Deforestation, rapid urbanization, and increased human-wildlife contact ensure that spillover events involving Ebola, Marburg, and Lassa fever will occur with greater frequency. The challenge is ensuring that initial clusters are contained before they reach the triple-digit fatality marks that periodically dominate global headlines. Vaccine Deployment and the Global Response The most significant advancement since the historic outbreaks is the approval and deployment of the Ervebo vaccine (rVSV-ZEBOV), which has fundamentally altered outbreak response protocols. Utilizing a ring vaccination strategy, health workers prioritize immunizing primary and secondary contacts of confirmed patients, effectively creating a biological firewall around the virus. Despite this scientific triumph, logistical hurdles persist. The vaccine requires ultra-cold chain storage, maintaining temperatures of minus 80 degrees Celsius (minus 112 degrees Fahrenheit). In rural African regions characterized by unreliable electricity grids and underdeveloped road networks, maintaining this cold chain is a monumental operational challenge that frequently delays rapid deployment to ground zero. Ervebo Efficacy: Clinical trials demonstrated nearly 100 percent efficacy when administered within 10 days of exposure. Stockpile Targets: The International Coordinating Group (ICG) on Vaccine Provision aims to maintain a global emergency stockpile of 500,000 doses. Cold Chain Costs: Establishing temporary ultra-cold infrastructure in remote outbreak zones can exceed USD 2 million (KES 260 million) per deployment. Regional Preparedness and the Kenyan Bridge East Africa has become a critical proving ground for hemorrhagic fever preparedness. In Kenya, the Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) maintains rigorous surveillance protocols at key transit hubs, notably Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, which serves as a primary aviation gateway connecting Central and West Africa to the globe. Neighboring Uganda offers a recent template for effective containment. During its 2022 outbreak of the Sudan ebolavirus strain—for which the Ervebo vaccine is ineffective—the Ugandan Ministry of Health successfully contained the spread within months through aggressive contact tracing, community engagement, and rapid isolation protocols. Ugandan officials demonstrated that even without targeted vaccines, robust public health infrastructure can prevent localized clusters from reaching catastrophic historical fatality figures. International Funding and Sovereign Capability The reliance on international funding mechanisms, such as the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and European Union grants, remains a point of vulnerability. African health ministers are increasingly advocating for sovereign bio-manufacturing capabilities to reduce dependency on Western stockpiles. Initiatives like the African Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) are pushing for the localized production of diagnostics and therapeutics. For the African diaspora in the United States and the United Kingdom, outbreak reports frequently trigger xenophobic travel restrictions and severe economic disruptions. Ensuring that African nations can autonomously identify, sequence, and neutralize outbreaks is not just a health imperative; it is an economic defense strategy. As historical death tolls continue to serve as grim reminders of the pathogen's potential, the true metric of Africa's progress will be the outbreaks that are quietly extinguished before they ever make the headlines. news.content_title: Which countries currently report high‐consequence infectious diseases: The up‐to‐date country risk list
news.content: The country-by-country reference list for high‐consequence infectious diseases (HCIDs) used by UK clinicians has been updated. According to guidance from the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), last revised on 23 July 2026, the resource collates where specific HCIDs have been recorded and the nature of evidence supporting each entry. It is designed to support rapid risk assessment in clinical settings and will be updated as new information arises. The update follows a period of heightened international vigilance. On 17 May 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) related to an outbreak of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. While the UKHSA table is not travel advice, it offers a structured, evidence-based way for health professionals to gauge whether a country has recently reported laboratory-confirmed, locally acquired human cases of HCIDs or other relevant indicators. What the country risk list shows The guidance presents a global overview of countries with a known occurrence of HCIDs since 1970. It flags where recent, locally acquired cases have been confirmed and distinguishes these from imported or laboratory-acquired cases. UKHSA notes that the greatest clinical relevance is typically where a country has documented recent, laboratory-confirmed local transmission. Crucially, the guidance cautions that the absence of a recorded HCID in a country does not rule out the possibility of future occurrence if the necessary transmission factors exist. It also emphasises that human serology findings can be difficult to interpret and may not reflect where an exposure actually occurred, especially for pathogens with serological cross-reactivity. Risk assessments should therefore consider individual exposure histories, travel itineraries and activities undertaken, in addition to the country-level signals. How to read the evidence codes Each country entry includes a code that indicates the type of evidence supporting the listing: (a) Community transmission or transmission from a reservoir (for example, zoonotic). Community transmission or transmission from a reservoir (for example, zoonotic). (b) Limited local transmission associated with an imported or laboratory-acquired case (for example, household spread). Limited local transmission associated with an imported or laboratory-acquired case (for example, household spread). (c) Imported or laboratory-acquired case with no onward transmission. Imported or laboratory-acquired case with no onward transmission. (d) Human serology (for example, findings from serological studies). UKHSA advises interpreting this with caution. Human serology (for example, findings from serological studies). UKHSA advises interpreting this with caution. (e) Unknown or limited information. Dates in the table refer to the most recent year associated with the evidence type listed. The guidance does not include data prior to 1970. Selected examples from the latest listings Country entries span A to Z and cover viral haemorrhagic fevers, certain severe respiratory pathogens, plague and other HCIDs. The following examples, drawn from the guidance, illustrate how the codes are used and why recency matters: Afghanistan: Crimean‐Congo haemorrhagic fever (CCHF) — community transmission (2026); Plague — community transmission (2007). Crimean‐Congo haemorrhagic fever (CCHF) — community transmission (2026); Plague — community transmission (2007). Argentina: Junin virus — community or zoonotic transmission (2026); Andes virus — community transmission (2019) with isolated cases in 2026. Junin virus — community or zoonotic transmission (2026); Andes virus — community transmission (2019) with isolated cases in 2026. China: Avian influenza A(H5N1) — community/zoonotic transmission (2025); Severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) — community transmission (2004); CCHF — community transmission (2023), among other entries. Avian influenza A(H5N1) — community/zoonotic transmission (2025); Severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) — community transmission (2004); CCHF — community transmission (2023), among other entries. Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola — community transmission (2026); Marburg — community transmission (1998); CCHF — community transmission (2008). These examples sit alongside many other entries in the UKHSA table, including avian influenza subtypes, Lassa fever, Marburg virus disease, Nipah virus infection, Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS), plague and other HCIDs. Clinicians should consult the full country list on the UKHSA webpage for comprehensive, up‐to‐date information. Why this matters for UK clinical practice For frontline teams, the table helps frame an initial index of suspicion when assessing unwell patients with relevant travel histories or exposure narratives. However, UKHSA stresses that country-level signals are only one part of a clinical risk assessment. A patient’s precise itinerary, activities (such as healthcare work, animal contact, caving, or attendance at funerals), and known exposures (including to vectors or reservoirs) are often more predictive than the country alone. Healthcare professionals who need to discuss a possible HCID case should first contact a local infection specialist (for example, a consultant in infectious diseases, microbiology or virology). Infection specialists should then contact the Imported Fever Service about suspected HCID cases as appropriate, and refer to the relevant UKHSA guidance linked from the country tables. This escalation pathway ensures rapid expert input, appropriate diagnostics and safe patient management. The WHO’s PHEIC concerning Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda underlines the need for ongoing vigilance. While the UKHSA country list is not a travel advisory, it can support the structured, timely assessment of febrile illness in returning travellers, humanitarian workers and others with potential exposures. Readers should note that reported country-level risk does not automatically translate to risk for any individual traveller; exposure context remains paramount. Key caveats when interpreting entries Serology is not definitive on its own: Human serology (code d) can reflect prior exposure that may have occurred elsewhere, and cross-reactivity can complicate interpretation. Human serology (code d) can reflect prior exposure that may have occurred elsewhere, and cross-reactivity can complicate interpretation. Absence of reports is not absence of risk: Countries without recorded HCID cases may still report them in future if vectors, reservoirs or other transmission factors are present. Countries without recorded HCID cases may still report them in future if vectors, reservoirs or other transmission factors are present. Recency and confirmation matter: Recent, laboratory-confirmed, locally acquired cases (typically coded a) carry the most immediate relevance for clinical risk assessment. Where to find the latest information The complete, continuously updated country listings are available on GOV.UK: High consequence infectious disease: country specific risk. The page explains how to use the guidance, provides links to UKHSA’s disease-specific resources, and sets out the evidence codes used in the table. For suspected cases requiring specialist input, see the Imported Fever Service guidance. Broader situational updates and international declarations, including PHEIC announcements, are available from the World Health Organization. Clinicians are encouraged to review the UKHSA page directly for the most current entries and to consider country signals alongside detailed exposure histories when assessing patients

ESTATE DIGGER TRIBUTES LIVE: KTN LIVE: Radio Maisha LIVE: Spice FM LIVE: Berur FM Kenya's health system put to test amid Ebola preparedness Health & Science By Mercy Kahenda | 3w ago | 4 min read The plan for an Ebola quarantine facility at the Laikipia Air Base to manage Americans exposed to the disease has reignited debate about Kenya's capacity to handle such outbreaks. Health experts says there is need for the country to demonstrate readiness in handling the disease, in critical areas, including isolation infrastructure, laboratory diagnostic capacity, a well-trained health workforce, surveillance systems, and emergency response logistics.Medical Facilities & Services Prof Matilu Mwau, a senior researcher at the Kenya Medical Research Institute, says the country has considerable human resources expertise, but requires better financing, bespoke research and development, collaborations and partnerships, and technological integration. Even if all these requirements were in place, he observes they would be insufficient unless there was responsive, capable leadership and governance. "Ebola is a complex problem requiring a complex response. Some of the challenges it poses can be dealt with at the technical level, requiring a little more money, more skills, bespoke infrastructure,” says Prof Matilu. He adds that some of the challenges it poses have no technical solution, and the solutions do not lie only in investing in the techniques of the natural sciences, but rather also require a change Kenya’s culture, morals, and attitudes. As an example, the scientist maintains that a major problem with Ebola is its highly infectious nature..Keep Reading From Monkey pox, Covid-19 and Nipah virus: Why animal-to-human diseases are on the riseComputer Science WHO declares international emergency as Ebola kills over 80 in DR Congo Duale: No Ebola in Kenya as DRC outbreak kills 88, reaches Uganda Duale: Three suspected Ebola cases tested negative, surveillance upped Prof Omu Anzala, a virologist, says: "The question is not whether we have a health system. The question is how prepared are we as a country?" "Are our border screening systems effective? Do we have enough quarantine facilities? Are healthcare workers adequately trained to respond if a case is detected?" he adds. Prof Anzala warns that, a single Ebola case can quickly trigger a public health emergency due to the extensive contact tracing required to contain transmission. "If we start having confirmed Ebola cases and multiple contacts, how equipped are we to quarantine, monitor and manage them? One Ebola case is already one too many, and even best hospital in Nairobi wont help stop the spread,” observes the researcher. In an outbreak, there will be well trained responders at all levels, including health care providers and scientists, equipped with Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) who are present and know exactly what to do.Biological Sciences There will also be responders who should not be in that area at all, and if around, will endanger the whole country. Furthermore, even patients can be situationally unaware, casual, careless or reckless. “There may be decision makers who, though highly competent in the generic sense, have no perception of the danger, have no knowledge of the vocabulary of the science, and will generally not respond tidily and timeously or even predictably because they need to be briefed or educated first,” observes the scientist. “In the end, the problems are sufficiently complex to require best and brightest minds. Having skills and training is very good, but it is not enough, being able to think and think quickly, and share high level knowledge, is so very important for an outbreak response,” adds Matilu. He cautions the country to be extremely careful that it can handle Ebola. “The fact that we are trained is not enough, we need to live the training not just say it. We must demonstrate the right attitude and situational awareness,” maintains Matilu.Emergency & Disaster Preparedness Currently, he says Kenya does not have a laboratory-Biosafety containment Level 4, (BSL4) that tests the most dangerous pathogens such as Ebola, Hantavirus, Lassa virus, Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus, Nipah Virus, Hendra Virus, Smallpox, Marburg and several other pathogens. In a BSL4 facility, he explains, when a person is inside the diagnostics facility, he is not in direct contact with pathogens being analysed. An individual manipulates the pathogens that are presented in a separate chamber. There is a barrier between the expert and pathogens and even while they conduct tests, the atmospheres in the different rooms are separated. Further, the researcher dresses up like a spaceman (astronaut), fitted with his own clean air supply. This ensures nothing escapes from the facility to the outside world because the pathogens are too dangerous.Public Health Whereas Kenya does not have a BSL4 facility, two countries in Africa have operational BSL4 facility namely South Africa and Gabon. Matilu explains since Ebola is commonly encountered from time to time, affected countries have been forced to improvise existing BSL3 facilities for diagnostics and lineage determination. “Us in Africa, we feel that Ebola is more or less a BSL3 pathogen, it's dangerous, no doubt, but if we handle it carefully, we shall be fine,” he observes. Matilu’s sentiments are echoed by Prof Julius Oyugi who adds that globally, there is no country that can handle emerging pathogens at 100 percent, Kenya included. “Kenya as a country has a very elaborate health system, that is used almost with everyone, there is also infrastructure, but it is never complete,” says Oyugi. Additionally, Dr Edwin Walong, a pathologist notes that a highly contagious diseases such as Ebola present additional challenges because they require advanced biosafety and containment facilities. analysis.brief_en: Kenya's health system faces scrutiny amid plans for an Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base to manage exposed Americans. Health experts highlight critical gaps in isolation infrastructure, laboratory capacity, workforce training, and emergency response logistics. A single Ebola case could overwhelm the system due to extensive contact tracing, experts warn. The assessment underscores challenges in border screening, quarantine facilities, and healthcare worker readiness. No outbreak is reported, but the debate reflects broader concerns about global emerging pathogen preparedness.

哺乳动物沙粒病毒(Mammarenavirus)是一类包膜双义单链RNA病毒,可引发人类致死性出血热及严重神经系统疾病。长期以来,鼠科(Muridae)啮齿动物被公认为其主要自然储存宿主,但近年来的宏基因组学与流行病学监测研究打破了这一传统认知,在非啮齿类宿主——尤其是真盲缺目(Eulipotyphla,含刺猬、鼩鼱)和兔形目(Lagomorpha,含鼠兔)——中发现了高度分化的新型哺乳动物沙粒病毒。本研究旨在整合全球范围内传统储存宿主中哺乳动物沙粒病毒的流行病学数据,以及非传统哺乳动物宿主中该类病毒复杂的生态学发现。研究人员系统分析了近期发表的分子监测数据、进化研究与流行病学报告,核心发现包括:亚洲家鼩鼱中发现的温州病毒(Wenzhou virus, WENV)、高原鼠兔中发现的 Plateau Pika virus(PPV),以及欧洲范围内呈地理聚集分布的刺猬相关沙粒病毒群。本综述最终明确了该类病原体的全球分布特征,强调了在全球范围内开展多宿主持续监测的迫切性,为完善人兽共患病风险评估体系提供了关键依据。1. 引言 下载阿尔茨海默病(AD)的明星治疗靶点最新进展,获取相关药物开发的最新进展。领 取哺乳动物沙粒病毒是重要的虫媒病毒,传统认知中以鼠科啮齿动物为核心自然储存宿主。该病毒归类于沙粒病毒科(Arenaviridae)哺乳动物沙粒病毒属(Mammarenavirus),同科还包括蚁病毒属(Antennavirus)、哈特曼病毒属(Hartmanivirus)、因诺病毒属(Innmovirus)和爬行沙粒病毒属(Reptarenavirus),分别感染鱼类、蛇类及未知宿主。其中,拉沙病毒(Lassa virus, LASV)、卢霍病毒(Lujo virus, LUJV)、胡宁病毒(Junin virus, JUNV)、马秋波病毒(Machupo virus, MACV)、瓜纳瑞托病毒(Guanarito virus, GTOV)和查帕雷病毒(Chapare virus, CHAPV)等可引发人类病毒性出血热(VHFs),在其流行区构成重大公共卫生威胁。 传统观点认为,哺乳动物沙粒病毒受限于特定啮齿类储存宿主,其进化遵循长期适应驱动的严格共分化范式。唯一的早期例外是塔卡里伯病毒(Tacaribe virus, TCRV),分离自叶鼻蝠属(Artibeus spp.)。因此,单个病毒的地理分布曾被认为由其对应宿主的分布范围决定,仅淋巴细胞性脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(Lymphocytic Choriomeningitis Virus, LCMV)通过其自然宿主小家鼠(Mus musculus)实现了全球扩散。然而,近期积累的宏基因组与比较系统发育数据推翻了这一范式:宿主转换而非共分化才是哺乳动物沙粒病毒进化的主要驱动力。部分病毒与特定啮齿亚科的关联更多由地理同域分布塑造,而非系统发育亲缘关系。在非啮齿类小型哺乳动物中发现的多种高度分化新病毒,揭示了其宿主范围已从啮齿目(Rodentia)扩展至真盲缺目、兔形目等远缘分类单元。这些发现表明,哺乳动物沙粒病毒具有较高的跨物种传播潜力,能够在远缘哺乳动物类群中建立稳定、自我维持的传播循环,而非仅导致一过性的终末溢出感染。本综述聚焦新识别的非啮齿类潜在储存宿主,评估宿主范围扩展的动态特征,为优化兽医监测框架、更新人兽交界区的疫情风险地图、支撑One Health体系预测和防范未来溢出事件提供实践参考。 2. 综述方法学 2.1 文献检索与研究筛选 本结构化叙述性综述系统分析哺乳动物沙粒病毒的流行病学、宿主关联及潜在人兽共患病风险。检索重点为非传统哺乳动物宿主(包括非鼠科啮齿类和非啮齿类哺乳动物)中的病毒感染或暴露证据,同时针对性检索病毒分类学、已确立储存宿主、传播途径及人兽共患病潜力的相关信息。检索于2026年3月30日启动,并于2026年6月28日更新,覆盖PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science核心合集、CAB Abstracts(CABI数字图书馆)及Google Scholar数据库。未设置发表年份与地理区域限制,仅纳入英文出版物。检索词包括“Mammarenavirus”“Arenaviridae”、各病毒种名,以及涉及野生动物、储存宿主、宿主范围和相关哺乳动物分类单元的关键词。 2.2 纳入标准与数据合成 纳入标准为报告自然感染或暴露哺乳动物沙粒病毒的同行评议原始研究,涵盖病毒-宿主关联的首次描述,以及后续关于流行率、地理分布、遗传多样性、组织嗜性和流行病学意义的研究。区分直接分子/病毒学检测与血清学暴露证据;仅当实验与体外研究涉及宿主易感性、病毒复制或人兽共患病潜力时才予纳入。综述、分类学报告、教科书及机构资料仅用于背景信息补充。提取的核心信息包括宿主物种、地理来源、生物样本类型、检测方法、病毒鉴定结果及种群水平的流行率数据。由于研究设计、采样策略、检测方法和结果报告的异质性较高,未进行流行率的统计学合并。PubMed初检获得1536条记录,所有数据库记录导入EndNote 21去重后,通过标题和摘要初筛排除无关研究,再对潜在相关文献的全文进行资格评估,同时通过追溯参考文献补充相关研究。 3. 病原学 哺乳动物沙粒病毒为包膜双义单链RNA病毒,呈球形或多形性,直径50–200 nm,外被源自宿主细胞质膜的脂质包膜。病毒表面均匀分布长8–10 nm、间距10 nm的棒状糖蛋白(GP)突起,每个突起由异二聚体三聚体构成,包含远端亚基GP1、跨膜亚基GP2和稳定信号肽(SSP)。其中GP1负责结合宿主细胞受体,GP2介导低pH环境下病毒包膜与内体膜的融合,SSP则是糖蛋白成熟的关键组分。 病毒基因组为二分节结构,包含大(L)节段(约7.2 kb)和小(S)节段(约3.5 kb)。L节段编码锌结合基质蛋白(Z)和病毒RNA依赖的RNA聚合酶(L),S节段编码包膜GP前体。两个节段的5'和3'端均含有19–30 nt的保守反向互补非翻译区(UTR),可形成非共价闭合的“柄环”结构,作为复制启动子。病毒采用双义编码策略,每个节段沿相反方向编码两个非重叠基因,中间由高度结构化的基因间区(IGR)分隔,后者折叠成稳定的发夹环结构以终止转录。 4. 流行病学与宿主储存库 根据地理分布、抗原性及系统发育关系,哺乳动物沙粒病毒分为旧世界(OW)和新世界(NW)沙粒病毒,分别对应LASV-LCMV和TCRV血清复合群。两类群均为多系起源,既包含人致病株也包含非致病株,目前已确定50余个病毒种,另有近年来在蝙蝠、刺猬和鼠兔中发现的多株未分类哺乳动物沙粒病毒。旧世界群主要流行于东半球,包含原型毒株LASV和LCMV,以及新发LUJV。LASV引发的拉沙热(LF)在西非(尼日利亚、利比里亚、几内亚、塞拉利昂)流行度高、死亡率显著,估算每年感染人数超90万,被世界卫生组织列为因流行潜力和缺乏有效防控措施而构成最高公共卫生风险的疾病之一。2008年在南非识别的LUJV与输入性人类出血热暴发相关,虽人类病死率高,但其具体宿主范围和地理分布仍不明确。LCMV则呈全球分布,除南极洲外在各大陆均有流行,人类感染临床表现从轻度自限性发热到严重脑膜炎、脑炎不等,孕期感染还可导致先天性脑积水、脉络膜视网膜炎等严重致畸结局。普通人群血清学调查显示LCMV抗体阳性率可达15%,但因临床表现非特异性、临床医生认知不足、诊断工具有限及报告不规范,其公共卫生威胁长期处于低估状态。 新世界群局限于美洲,包含多种引发严重出血热的致病因子:JUNV导致阿根廷出血热;MACV和CHAPV分别导致玻利维亚出血热和查帕雷出血热;GTOV引发委内瑞拉出血热;SABV导致巴西出血热。除阿根廷出血热流行病学数据较完备外,其他南美相关疾病的流行率仍不明确。怀特沃特阿罗约病毒作为北美哺乳动物沙粒病毒,也被认为具有人兽共患病风险,与美国境内致死性出血热病例相关。已知哺乳动物沙粒病毒的主要储存宿主为鼠总科(Muroidea)啮齿动物:旧世界病毒主要关联鼠科(Muridae)鼠亚科(Murinae)成员,西非LASV的流行由 Natal多乳鼠(Mastomys natalensis)维持,该物种为撒哈拉以南非洲优势啮齿类,常栖息于农村人居周边。LASV的流行病学呈现显著季节性节律,旱季农业烧荒导致野生食物资源枯竭,迫使M. natalensis大规模迁入人居区域,显著提升家庭储粮与水源的病毒污染风险。与热带局部流行的LASV不同,LCMV的全球分布与其主要宿主小家鼠的广泛分布一致。 新世界病毒主要关联仓鼠科(Cricetidae)啮齿动物,其中南美洲以棉鼠亚科(Sigmodontinae)为核心储存宿主,北美洲以林鼠亚科(Neotominae)为主。JUNV主要由干地暮鼠(Calomys musculinus)和小暮鼠(Calomys laucha)维持;短尾蔗鼠(Zygodontomys brevicauda)是GTOV的主要储存宿主,偶见于阿尔斯通棉鼠(Sigmodon alstoni);大暮鼠(Calomys callosus)携带MACV,实验感染后可慢性携带JUNV。怀特沃特阿罗约病毒分离自白喉林鼠(Neotoma albigula)、墨西哥林鼠(Neotoma mexicana)、小足林鼠(Neotoma micropus)和岩林鼠(Neotoma cinerea)。CHAPV和SABV的自然宿主尚未明确,推测仍为啮齿动物。TCRV是另一例外,最初从特立尼达和多巴哥的叶鼻蝠及蚊类中分离,后在佛罗里达州孤星蜱(Amblyomma americanum)中检出,提示其可能在热带美洲蝙蝠种群中循环,但具体储存宿主和地理范围仍有争议。 哺乳动物沙粒病毒在自然储存宿主体内通常引发无症状感染,表现为慢性病毒血症及通过分泌物、排泄物长期排出高滴度病毒。水平感染的成年啮齿动物多可清除病毒并获得终身免疫,而发育早期发生的垂直传播常导致终身持续性感染,这是病毒在自然界维持的关键机制。人类主要通过吸入被啮齿动物尿液或粪便污染的雾化液滴或粉尘、摄入污染的食物水源、污染物接触破损皮肤等途径感染,暴露风险随人类活动与储存宿主栖息地的重叠而增加。此外,处理和食用啮齿动物肉类也是重要传播途径,尤其在依赖丛林肉的低资源社区。啮齿动物咬伤传播相对少见。人际水平传播罕见,但已有器官移植后传播及医疗机构感染防控不足导致的传播报道。LCMV可通过母婴垂直传播,性传播则极为罕见。系统发育分析显示西非LASV的人类毒株早于啮齿动物毒株,提示环境污染物暴露可能导致人类向啮齿动物的“回溢”传播。 5. 新发哺乳动物沙粒病毒与新型宿主 近年宏基因组与野生动物监测研究识别出多种新型哺乳动物沙粒病毒,大幅扩展了该属已知的宿主范围。2013年在中国温州地区首次发现的温州病毒(WENV,种名Mammarenavirus wenzhouense)是首个跨目传播的哺乳动物沙粒病毒证据。对351份啮齿动物样本的筛查显示,病毒RNA在Rattus属和Niviventer属啮齿动物中的检出率为12.0%,在真盲缺目亚洲家鼩鼱(Suncus murinus)中的检出率为4.4%。全基因组测序显示该病毒聚类于已知旧世界哺乳动物沙粒病毒群。实验感染证实WENV具有强系统性组织嗜性,可在啮齿类和鼩鼱的粪便及肝、肺、心、肾、脾中检出病毒RNA。后续研究显示WENV及其变异株在亚洲广泛分布,宿主范围覆盖多种Rattus属物种、小家鼠和黑线姬鼠(Apodemus agrarius),但由于S. murinus中病毒流行率较低且缺乏纵向排毒数据,鼩鼱在WENV流行病学中的生态角色尚未明确。柬埔寨的研究在柬埔塞褐家鼠和太平洋鼠中检测到WENV变异株Cardamones,对人类临床样本的检测显示,17.4%的流感样症状且登革热、流感检测阴性患者,以及13.2%的健康人群存在WENV IgG血清阳性反应,0.6%的有呼吸道症状患者的呼吸道标本中检出病毒RNA,但因症状轻微非特异性、半数阳性者合并其他呼吸道病原体感染及样本量有限,未能确立明确的因果关联。中国两项省份的健康人群血清学调查显示儿童WENV血清阳性率为1.5%,成人为4.6%,低于东南亚报道数据,可能与检测方法特异性更高及地理、时间差异有关,这些发现提示需加强对该新发病毒的关注与研究。 跳鼠沙粒病毒(JEAreV,后续归类为Mammarenavirus alashanense,阿拉善病毒)的发现首次证实哺乳动物沙粒病毒的宿主范围可从传统鼠科扩展至非鼠科啮齿类(跳鼠科Dipodidae),提示病毒分化可发生在孤立的生态位中。2014年从中国内蒙古的三趾跳鼠(Dipus sagitta)中识别的该病毒总体流行率为8.0%,且具有严格的宿主特异性,在同域分布的其他跳鼠物种(如长耳跳鼠Euchoreutes naso、西伯利亚五趾跳鼠Allactaga sibirica)中未检出。基于L和S节段的系统发育分析将JEAreV置于旧世界群内,但处于高度独立的分支,结合环境中无其他替代啮齿类宿主的证据,提示JEAreV是在沙漠啮齿类生态位中独立进化形成的稳定种特异性定居者,而非来自同域鼠科啮齿动物的偶然溢出。 除鼩鼱外,真盲缺目其他类群的发现进一步挑战了哺乳动物沙粒病毒严格依赖啮齿类宿主的范式。对猬科(Erinaceidae)刺猬的研究提供了该类群中病毒循环的确凿证据。匈牙利北白胸刺猬(Erinaceus roumanicus)中检测到的高度分化梅切克山病毒(MEMV)是首个证实沙粒病毒与猬科动物关联的报道。尽管该病毒与阿拉善病毒遗传亲缘性较高,但成对序列一致性低于国际病毒分类委员会(ICTV)的种划分阈值,因此被归类为旧世界群新种Mammarenavirus mecsekense。2025年匈牙利对更多刺猬粪便样本的筛查又鉴定出5个新型哺乳动物沙粒病毒毒株,虽与已知MEMV亲缘最近,但序列和系统发育分析显示其具有独特的基因组基序,可能代表第二个新种,暂定名为潘诺尼亚哺乳动物沙粒病毒(PANV),提示匈牙利的Erinaceus roumanicus至少携带两种不同的哺乳动物沙粒病毒。平行研究显示刺猬与哺乳动物沙粒病毒的关联并非局限于单一国家,而是呈现欧洲范围内的复杂共循环格局:俄罗斯欧洲部分的Erinaceus属物种口腔和肛门拭子中鉴定出的高度变异毒株被统称为刺猬沙粒病毒(EriAreV),虽归入侵蝟沙粒病毒分支,但高遗传多样性支持其作为独立新种;2025年意大利欧洲刺猬(Erinaceus europaeus)的肝、十二指肠样本中检出4个欧洲刺猬沙粒病毒(EEAV)毒株,与白胸刺猬MEMV亲缘最近,但根据种划分标准应视为独立新种。对匈牙利、俄罗斯、意大利及数据库中中国刺猬(Erinaceus amurensis)序列的系统发育分析显示,所有刺猬来源的哺乳动物沙粒病毒在旧世界群内形成一个独立分支,与MEMV和阿拉善病毒聚类,且毒株按地理起源聚集,至少代表5个潜在的刺猬相关哺乳动物沙粒病毒新种。这些发现证实猬科动物并非偶然溢出宿主,而是多个独立哺乳动物沙粒病毒种的特异性进化储存库。意大利阳性欧洲刺猬的脑、脾、肾、肺等多脏器中检出病毒RNA,且无明显组织病理学损伤;俄罗斯阳性刺猬在严格隔离的冬眠个体中仍可检出病毒,均支持病毒在刺猬体内长期持续存在,与啮齿类储存宿主中典型的慢性无症状排毒动力学高度一致。 青藏高原高原鼠兔(Ochotona curzoniae)中发现的Plateau Pika virus(PPV,种名Mammarenavirus batangense)是首个在兔形目中识别的哺乳动物沙粒病毒。6.3%的肠道样本中检出PPV RNA,且肺、肾、心、肝、脾等内脏器官中也存在高病毒载量,证实鼠兔为PPV的自然宿主。系统发育分析显示PPV与传统旧世界、新世界哺乳动物沙粒病毒分化程度极高,可能代表一个古老谱系,约在7700–8800万年前与传统哺乳动物沙粒病毒发生分歧,远早于经典旧世界与新世界群的估计分歧时间。同一研究将野生动物监测与人类临床风险直接关联,青藏高原高海拔地区的人类回顾性血清学调查显示PPV血清阳性率达2.4%,结合体外实验证实PPV可高效感染并在人类及非人灵长类细胞系中复制的证据,初步提示了该病毒跨物种传播给人类的潜力。 6. 讨论 新型沙粒病毒与新宿主的发现表明,哺乳动物沙粒病毒属的真实多样性仍远未被认知,可能还存在于大量未被研究的哺乳动物类群中。在匈牙利MEMV发现之前,学界普遍认为欧洲的哺乳动物沙粒病毒流行病学仅涉及单一流行种——全球分布的LCMV。随后在欧洲大陆猬科动物中识别出的复杂、呈地理聚集分布的独立病毒种网络(匈牙利的PANV、俄罗斯的EriAreV、意大利的EEAV),重塑了对哺乳动物沙粒病毒与宿主协同进化及其在欧洲流行病学特征的理解。重要的是,解剖和冬眠刺猬中观察到的系统性组织嗜性和长期病毒持续存在,强烈支持这些食虫动物是稳定的种特异性进化储存库,而非来自同域啮齿动物的偶然一过性溢出。 宿主范围向鼩鼱等真盲缺目动物及鼠兔等兔形目动物扩展具有重要的公共卫生意义。东南亚地区已发现WENV暴露与人类显著的血清阳性率相关,且在人类呼吸道标本中检出病毒RNA;青藏高原的回顾性血清学调查也证实了人类对PPV的暴露。虽然高原鼠兔的系统性复制支持其作为PPV储存宿主的地位,但人畜共患溢出的绝对风险仍需进一步研究验证。 除新病毒发现外,近期研究还显示已知病毒种在意外宿主中的检出率上升。典型案例如LCMV,历史上几乎仅与小家鼠关联,但目前已在wood小鼠(Apodemus sylvaticus)、松鼠(Sciurus vulgaris)、田鼠(Microtus agrestis)、巢鼠(Micromys minutus)、圈养黑尾草原犬鼠(Cynomys ludovicianus)和褐家鼠(Rattus norvegicus)中检出核酸或抗体。加蓬的监测更在Lophuromys sikapusi啮齿动物和Atherurus africanus豪猪中检出LCMV RNA,在African pygmy小鼠(Mus minutoides)、非洲软毛鼠(Praomys missonei)和Crocidura goliath鼩鼱中检出抗LCMV样抗体。LASV的储存宿主范围也在扩展:除主要宿主M. natalensis外,已在Guinea多乳鼠(Mastomys erythroleucus)、Mus baoulei和Hylomyscus pamfi等啮齿动物中检出LASV。类似现象也见于其他类病毒在非常规宿主中的检出。鉴于此,哺乳动物沙粒病毒的流行病学调查应突破传统啮齿类储存宿主的限制,将替代性野生动物宿主纳入同等深度的监测范畴。 7. 结论 哺乳动物沙粒病毒宿主范围持续扩展的证据引发了对其人兽共患病潜力的担忧,尤其考虑到该类病毒已明确可致人类感染。未来亟需填补关键研究空白,全面评估新发哺乳动物沙粒病毒的人兽共患病与溢出风险。首先,必须将监测范围从传统啮齿类种群扩展至新型潜在储存宿主,以识别未知病毒库、阐明驱动宿主适应的分子机制、解析该属真实的进化多样性。核心科学问题之一是明确新识别的非啮齿类小型哺乳动物是偶然宿主还是具备种内传播能力的合格自然储存宿主,这需要结合野生动物种群的长期纵向生态监测与替代宿主的宏基因组筛查予以解答。其次,青藏高原人类2.4%的PPV血清阳性率提示需在与新型野生动物宿主共享生境的人群中扩大血清学监测规模。最后,随着人为环境侵占和气候驱动的生态变迁不断模糊野生动物与人类聚居地的边界,需在One Health框架下整合分子、生态与血清学数据,以实现对新发人兽共患哺乳动物沙粒病毒的预测、检测与防控。 打赏 展开全文 开通VIP 享海量文章 全站开放获取+解锁超过 200万篇新闻全文+每日更新 2000+篇,学术前沿动态全时追踪! 从2000到2026,27载全因有您;您的每一分支持,都给予我们无穷的动力! 公测期:打赏8元解锁30天免费阅读!
